newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering hits high on Japan pill report.
newsitem.headline: Schering hits high on Japan pill report.

text.p: Shares in German drugs company Schering AG hit an all-time high in bourse trade, driven higher by speculation that the Japanese government may soon remove its ban on the oral contraceptive pill.

At 1221 GMT shares in Schering were up 7.75 marks, or 5.30 percent, at 153.95 marks, having earlier hit record highs at 155 marks, after the Financial Times newspaper said a Japanese government report said pills were safe and effective.
The overall DAX index was slightly higher at 3,235.91 points, up 2.70 points or 0.08 percent.
Schering is a large manufacturer of oral contraceptives, which have been banned in Japan since their introduction 30 years ago.
